subject: Certificate routing & broker staging plan for Stonebridge MSA / Order Form
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stonebridgelabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stonebridgelabs.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Insurance evidence + timing for MSA/order form

Hi Sofia,

We're finishing our procurement checklist on the MSA + Order Form and need the insurance evidence before we can route for final PO approval. Can your team provide the COI and endorsement naming Stonebridge Labs as Additional Insured and confirming the coverage minimums? Our broker also asked for an expected delivery window so they can align their endorsement timing.

Key coverage we require (for reference):
- Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Auto Liability (if vehicles used): $1,000,000 combined single limit
- Professional / E&O: $2,000,000
- Cyber/Privacy: $5,000,000

If possible, could you also indicate whether Redwood will accept the CG 20 10 or an equivalent Additional Insured endorsement, and whether waiver of subrogation is available?

Thanks — we want to keep the Order Form signoff this month.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Stonebridge Labs

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stonebridgelabs.com>, Kurt Haines <kurt.h@acuitybrokers.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Insurance evidence + timing for MSA/order form

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Kurt at Acuity (our broker) and Marissa from Legal so we can align on wording and delivery. Proposed plan below: 

1) Coverage minimums: Redwood can confirm the limits you listed for this deal (CGL 1M/2M, Auto 1M, E&O 2M, Cyber 5M). We can reflect these on the COI.
2) Additional Insured: We can provide an endorsement. We prefer CG 20 10 (or equivalent form) naming “Stonebridge Labs, its subsidiaries and affiliates” as additional insured for work performed under the Order Form.
3) Waiver of Subrogation: Needs Legal sign-off for an unconditional waiver; Marissa can advise.
4) Delivery window: Kurt, can Acuity stage the COI + endorsement for automatic upload to the Redwood evidence bucket by next Tuesday (2027-09-21)? If so, that keeps Stonebridge’s PO schedule intact.
5) Routing: once Kurt uploads, I’ll confirm receipt and add the signed Order Form to the shared Drive link and send a final confirmation to your legal/procurement team.

Attachments I’ll push once Kurt confirms staging: OrderForm-v3.docx (final for signature).

Open questions for Legal (Marissa): any redline restrictions on the Additional Insured wording or limits on waiver of subrogation for this account?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stonebridgelabs.com>, Kurt Haines <kurt.h@acuitybrokers.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Insurance evidence + timing for MSA/order form

Folks — quick legal note:
- Additional Insured: CG 20 10 is acceptable, but we need the endorsement to state coverage "for ongoing operations and completed operations" tied to the Order Form. If the broker provides a manuscript form, legal should receive a PDF to confirm equivalence.
- Waiver of Subrogation: We can accept a waiver for the CGL only if it is limited to direct liability claims arising from Redwood’s operations. We should avoid a broad unconditional waiver across all policy lines without exec approval.
- Professional Liability / Cyber: verify retroactive dates and that there are no prior acts exclusions that would carve out relevant incidents.

Kurt — please provide the endorsement PDF and COI with explicit policy numbers and carrier names. Also include the effective/expiration dates so we can validate coverage spans the contract term.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Kurt Haines <kurt.h@acuitybrokers.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stonebridgelabs.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: COI + endorsement (staged for upload) — Stonebridge / Redwood

Team — attaching the COI and the Additional Insured endorsement. Staging plan: I will upload the files to Redwood’s secure evidence S3 bucket (bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/stonebridge/DEAL-7821) by end of day Tuesday 2027-09-21. Files attached here for immediate legal review:
- COI_Stonebridge_20270921.pdf (COI listing carriers & policy numbers)
- Endorsement_AddlInsured_CG-2010.pdf (endorsement; names Stonebridge Labs, its subsidiaries and affiliates)

Notes:
- Endorsement includes wording for ongoing and completed operations; waiver of subrogation is included for CGL only (limited to claims arising from Redwood’s work).
- Professional/E&O and Cyber policies confirm limits and list retroactive dates — contained in the COI notes.

Let me know if you need a certified/insurer-signed endorsement; I can request that but it may add 3–5 business days.

Kurt Haines
Senior Broker, Acuity Brokers

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

- If accepted, I’ll send the DocuSign routing (OrderForm-v3) and target final signature by 2027-09-28.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
